objective: Check semantic equality of TSRS type-position query results and pinned TypeScript parameter binding types over a broader HMR-relevant fixture

method.query: For each simple identifier parameter, sent its UTF-16 binding position to the Quench TSRS worker, which ran getTypesAtPositions then typeToString.
method.oracle: Generated `Expect<Equal<typeof x, TSRS type text>>` checks in each function body and ran the pinned native tsc with --noEmit against the same tsconfig.
method.stability_check: Repeated TSRS queries after inserting the assertions; the query results were unchanged.
method.unique_symbol: TSRS prints `unique symbol`, which is not valid standalone TypeScript type syntax. For this case the equivalence assertion used the source alias `typeof uniqueKey`; all other TSRS output strings were used verbatim.

scope: Semantic equality for these 30 queried parameter bindings under two strict compiler configurations. This does not prove full checker API, diagnostics, project-resolution, library, or all compiler-option compatibility.
